name: workspace
description: A calculator for what a homelab costs to leave running. Add the gear, type a rate or start from a published average, and you get energy and cost for a day, a month, and a year. What-if cards cover downtime, stuffing several machines onto one host, and how long an upgrade takes to pay for itself.
